exodus.13.p1.b1.text: “Consecrate to Me every firstborn male. The firstborn from every womb among the Israelites belongs to Me, both of man and beast.”

exodus.13.p1.b2.text: Remember this day, the day you came out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery; for the LORD brought you out of it by the strength of His hand.

exodus.13.p1.b3.text: And nothing leavened shall be eaten.

exodus.13.p1.b4.text: Today, in the month of Abib, you are leaving.

exodus.13.p2.b5.text: And when the LORD brings you into the land of the Canaanites…the land He swore to your fathers that He would give you, a land flowing with milk and honey—you shall keep this service in this month.

exodus.13.p2.b6.text: For seven days you are to eat unleavened bread, and on the seventh day there shall be a feast to the LORD.

exodus.13.p2.b7.text: This is because of what the LORD did for me when I came out of Egypt.

exodus.13.p2.b8.text: It shall be a sign for you on your hand and a reminder on your forehead that the Law of the LORD is to be on your lips…

exodus.13.p3.b9.text: You must redeem every firstborn donkey with a lamb…And every firstborn of your sons you must redeem.

exodus.13.p3.b11.text: With a mighty hand the LORD brought us out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.

exodus.13.p3.b12.text: …but I redeem all the firstborn of my sons.

exodus.13.p4.b13.text: God did not lead them along the road through the land of the Philistines, though it was shorter.

exodus.13.p4.b14.text: If the people face war, they might change their minds and return to Egypt.

exodus.13.p4.b15.text: Moses took the bones of Joseph with him

exodus.13.p4.b16.text: God will surely attend to you, and then you must carry my bones with you from this place.

exodus.13.p5.b17.text: And the LORD went before them in a pillar of cloud to guide their way by day,

exodus.13.p5.b18.text: and in a pillar of fire to give them light by night, so that they could travel by day or night.

exodus.13.p5.b19.text: Neither the pillar of cloud by day nor the pillar of fire by night left its place before the people.
